row: Dr. Randy Aronson - The Pet Vet

Dr. Randy Aronson is a holistic, integrative veterinarian specializing in advanced natural pet health and wellness. As the owner of PAWS Veterinary Center in Tucson, AZ, Dr. Randy shares his 40+ years of experience on how to care for pets using an integrative approach—combining traditional Western medicine with science-based holistic modalities like pet acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, and advanced nutrition. The goals—and any treatment & rehabilitation plans—for his patients are built around longevity and healthspan.  

Dr. Randy is certified by the Canine Rehabilitation Institute and utilizes cutting-edge therapies—food therapy, ozone, shock wave, acupuncture, therapeutic laser, and underwater treadmill—to treat chronic pain, arthritis, and mobility issues in dogs and cats. Subscribe to Paws, Reflect, and Heal for expert advice, Q&As, and proactive solutions for your pet's long-term health and wellness.
